probable_root_causes.cause: Improperly sealed or damaged aft field joint on the right Solid Rocket Booster

contributing_factors.factor: Inadequate inspection and maintenance procedures for the booster's aft field joint
Insufficient thermal protection or shielding on the External Tank

recommended_actions.action: Conduct a thorough inspection and maintenance program for all aft field joints on Solid Rocket Boosters
Review and revise thermal protection and shielding designs for the External Tank to prevent damage from external sources

probable_root_causes.cause: Faulty or damaged sensor array on the left wing
Malfunctioning tire pressure monitoring system in the left main gear wheel well

contributing_factors.factor: Inadequate communication protocols for emergency situations
Insufficient redundancy in critical systems (e.g. sensor arrays, communication links)

recommended_actions.action: Conduct thorough inspection and maintenance of all sensor arrays and tire pressure monitoring systems
Develop and implement emergency communication protocols for situations where voice communication is lost

probable_root_causes.cause: Premature loss of signal due to unknown anomaly

contributing_factors.factor: Unusual engine performance during main burn
Inadequate redundancy in communication systems

recommended_actions.action: Conduct thorough review of engine performance data and telemetry
Implement additional redundancy measures in communication systems

contributing_factors.factor: Insufficient redundancy in the flight control system
Inadequate testing of the automated flight termination system

recommended_actions.action: Conduct a thorough review of the flight control system's design and implementation to identify potential single points of failure
Develop and implement additional testing procedures for the automated flight termination system to ensure its reliability and robustness

probable_root_causes.cause: Faulty or damaged oxygen tank valve
Electrical power surge or malfunction on Main Bus B

contributing_factors.factor: Insufficient maintenance or inspection of Service Module systems
Inadequate crew training for emergency procedures

recommended_actions.action: Conduct thorough inspections and maintenance of Service Module systems before next mission
Develop and implement emergency procedure training for crew members

probable_root_causes.cause: Insufficient testing or validation of the return capsule's re-entry and descent sequence

contributing_factors.factor: Inadequate communication between ground control and the spacecraft during the re-entry phase
Lack of redundancy in the parachute deployment system

recommended_actions.action: Conduct a thorough investigation into the drogue parachute's design and testing process
Review and revise the return capsule's re-entry and descent sequence to include redundant systems for parachute deployment

probable_root_causes.cause: Unintended activation of Emergency Sun Pointing Mode
Inadequate momentum management and gyro calibration procedures

contributing_factors.factor: Insufficient training for ground controllers on emergency response protocols
Lack of redundant systems or backup power sources

recommended_actions.action: Review and revise momentum management and gyro calibration procedures to prevent unintended activation of Emergency Sun Pointing Mode
Provide additional training for ground controllers on emergency response protocols

probable_root_causes.cause: Premature activation of the primary science instrument's protective cover
Inadequate validation of the spacecraft's spin rate after orbital insertion and separation

contributing_factors.factor: Insufficient testing or simulation of the primary science instrument's activation sequence
Inadequate monitoring and response to telemetry anomalies by ground controllers

recommended_actions.action: Review and revise the primary science instrument's activation sequence to prevent premature cover ejection
Implement additional monitoring and alerting for telemetry anomalies related to spacecraft spin rate and instrument activation

contributing_factors.factor: Inadequate testing of spacecraft's rotation dynamics
Lack of real-time monitoring of satellite's attitude and health

recommended_actions.action: Conduct thorough review of spacecraft design and testing procedures to identify potential weaknesses
Implement real-time monitoring systems for satellite attitude, health, and performance

probable_root_causes.cause: Faulty or malfunctioning Reaction Control System (RCS) components
Inadequate testing and validation of the flight software's thruster control logic

contributing_factors.factor: Insufficient maintenance or inspection of the RCS components before the mission
Lack of redundancy in the propulsion system's helium supply and leak detection systems

recommended_actions.action: Conduct a thorough investigation into the RCS components' condition and functionality
Review and update the flight software's thruster control logic to ensure robustness and fault tolerance
